entries.name: joystick_check_button

entries.name: joystick_xpos

entries.name: joystick_upos

entries.name: joystick_vpos

entries.name: visible
entries.description: Whether the instance is drawn; invisible instances stay active and still cause collisions.

entries.name: sprite_index
entries.description: Index of the sprite the instance uses; changing it keeps the current subimage index.

entries.name: sprite_width
entries.description: Read-only width of the instance's sprite.

entries.name: sprite_height
entries.description: Read-only height of the instance's sprite.

entries.name: sprite_xoffset
entries.description: Read-only horizontal origin offset of the sprite.

entries.name: sprite_yoffset
entries.description: Read-only vertical origin offset of the sprite.

entries.name: image_number
entries.description: Read-only count of subimages in the current sprite.

entries.name: image_index
entries.description: Currently drawn subimage (from 0); fractional values are rounded down and animation continues from it.

entries.name: image_speed
entries.description: Subimage animation speed; 1 advances one subimage per step, 0 freezes on image_index.

entries.name: depth
entries.description: Draw-order depth (default 0); higher values are drawn behind lower ones.

entries.name: image_xscale
entries.description: Horizontal scale factor of the sprite; 1 is normal, -1 mirrors it.

entries.name: image_yscale
entries.description: Vertical scale factor of the sprite; 1 is normal, -1 flips it.

entries.name: image_angle
entries.description: Sprite rotation in degrees counterclockwise; 0 is unrotated.

entries.name: image_alpha
entries.description: Opacity when drawing the sprite, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).

entries.name: image_blend
entries.description: Blend color applied to the sprite when drawn; c_white means no tinting.

entries.name: bbox_left

entries.name: bbox_right

entries.name: bbox_top

entries.name: bbox_bottom
entries.description: Read-only bottom edge of the instance's bounding box in the room.

entries.name: background_color

entries.name: background_showcolor
entries.description: Whether the window is cleared with the background color.

entries.name: background_visible

entries.name: background_foreground
entries.description: Per-background (0-7) flag making the background draw as a foreground.

entries.name: background_y

entries.name: background_yscale

entries.name: background_hspeed

entries.name: background_vspeed

entries.name: draw_sprite_ext
entries.description: Draws a sprite with x/y scale, counterclockwise rotation in degrees, blend color and alpha.

entries.name: draw_sprite_tiled_ext

entries.name: draw_sprite_general

entries.description: Stretched background drawing with blend color and alpha.

entries.name: draw_background_tiled_ext
entries.description: Tiled background drawing with scale factors, blend color and alpha.

entries.name: draw_background_part

entries.name: draw_background_part_ext

entries.name: draw_background_general

entries.description: Adds a vertex with its own color and alpha, enabling smooth gradients.

entries.name: window_get_cursor

entries.name: window_set_color

entries.name: window_get_color

entries.name: window_get_region_scale
entries.description: Returns the drawing region scale factor.

entries.name: window_set_position
entries.description: Sets the position of the window's client area.

entries.name: window_set_size
entries.description: Sets the size of the window's client area, kept large enough for the drawing region.

entries.name: window_set_rectangle
entries.description: Sets window position and size in one call.

entries.name: window_center
entries.description: Centers the window on the screen.

entries.name: window_default
entries.description: Resets the window to default size and centered position.

entries.name: window_get_x
entries.description: Returns the window's x-coordinate.

entries.name: window_get_y
entries.description: Returns the window's y-coordinate.

entries.name: window_get_width
entries.description: Returns the window width.

entries.name: window_get_height
entries.description: Returns the window height.

entries.name: window_mouse_get_x
entries.description: Returns the mouse x-coordinate within the window.

entries.name: window_mouse_get_y
entries.description: Returns the mouse y-coordinate within the window.

entries.name: window_mouse_set
entries.description: Moves the mouse to (x,y) within the window.

entries.name: view_enabled
entries.description: Whether views are enabled.

entries.name: view_current
entries.description: Read-only index (0-7) of the view being drawn; use in draw events only.

entries.name: view_visible
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) flag for whether the view is shown.

entries.name: view_xview
entries.description: Array over views 0-7: left room coordinate of the area each view shows.

entries.name: view_yview
entries.description: Array over views 0-7: top room coordinate of the area each view shows.

entries.name: view_wview

entries.name: view_hview
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) height of the view in the room.

entries.name: view_xport
entries.description: Array over views 0-7: left screen/window coordinate where the view is drawn.

entries.name: view_yport
entries.description: Array over views 0-7: top screen/window coordinate where the view is drawn.

entries.name: view_wport
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) width of the viewport.

entries.name: view_hport
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) height of the viewport.

entries.name: view_angle
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) rotation in degrees counterclockwise.

entries.name: view_hborder
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) horizontal border in pixels kept around the followed object.

entries.name: view_vborder
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) vertical border in pixels kept around the followed object.

entries.name: view_hspeed
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) maximum horizontal scroll speed.

entries.name: view_vspeed
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) maximum vertical scroll speed.

entries.name: view_object
entries.description: Per-view (0-7) object (or instance id) the view follows; first instance if several.

entries.name: window_get_region_width

entries.name: window_get_region_height
entries.description: Returns the drawing region height.

entries.name: window_view_mouse_get_x
entries.description: Returns the mouse x-coordinate relative to view id.

entries.name: window_view_mouse_get_y
entries.description: Returns the mouse y-coordinate relative to view id.

entries.name: window_view_mouse_set
entries.description: Sets the mouse position relative to view id.

entries.description: Returns the mouse x-coordinate relative to the view it is in (same as mouse_x).

entries.name: window_views_mouse_get_y
entries.description: Returns the mouse y-coordinate relative to the view it is in (same as mouse_y).

entries.name: window_views_mouse_set
entries.description: Sets the mouse position relative to the first visible view.

entries.name: screen_redraw
entries.description: Redraws the room by running all draw events.

entries.name: screen_refresh
entries.description: Refreshes the screen from the current room image without running draw events.

entries.name: screen_wait_vsync
entries.description: Waits for the monitor's next vertical sync.

entries.name: set_automatic_draw
entries.description: Sets whether the room is redrawn automatically (default true).

entries.name: set_synchronization
entries.description: Sets whether drawing syncs with the monitor refresh rate.

entries.name: sound_play
entries.description: Starts a sound once; a background music sound being played replaces the current background music.

entries.name: sound_loop
entries.description: Starts a sound playing repeatedly; background music replaces the current background music.

entries.name: sound_stop
entries.description: Stops the given sound, including every simultaneously playing copy of it.

entries.name: sound_stop_all
entries.description: Stops every sound that is currently playing.

entries.name: sound_isplaying
entries.description: Tells whether a copy of the sound is audibly playing; may lag behind play/stop calls due to buffering and echo.

entries.name: sound_volume
entries.description: Sets the volume of one sound, from 0 (quiet) to 1 (loud).

entries.name: sound_global_volume
entries.description: Sets the master volume for all sounds, from 0 (quiet) to 1 (loud).

entries.name: sound_fade
entries.description: Gradually changes a sound volume to a target value (0 to 1) over a time in milliseconds.

entries.name: sound_pan
entries.description: Sets stereo pan of a sound: -1 left, 0 center, 1 right.

entries.name: sound_background_tempo
entries.description: Scales the tempo of midi background music by a factor (1 is normal, allowed 0.01 to 100).

entries.name: sound_set_search_directory
entries.description: Sets the folder where direct music files are looked for, given without a trailing backslash.

entries.name: se_none
entries.description: Sound effect flag meaning no effect applied.

entries.name: se_chorus
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the chorus effect.

entries.name: se_echo
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the echo effect.

entries.name: se_flanger
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the flanger effect.

entries.name: se_gargle
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the gargle effect.

entries.name: se_reverb
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the reverb effect.

entries.name: se_compressor
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the compressor effect.

entries.name: se_equalizer
entries.description: Sound effect flag selecting the equalizer effect.

entries.name: sound_effect_set
entries.description: Selects the effect or combination (added se_ constants) applied to a sound.

entries.name: sound_effect_chorus
entries.description: Configures chorus parameters (wetdry, depth, feedback, frequency, wave, delay, phase) for a sound.

entries.name: sound_effect_echo
entries.description: Configures echo parameters (wetdry, feedback, left/right delay, pandelay) for a sound.

entries.name: sound_effect_flanger
entries.description: Configures flanger parameters (wetdry, depth, feedback, frequency, wave, delay, phase) for a sound.

entries.name: sound_effect_gargle
entries.description: Configures gargle effect with modulation rate in Hz (1 to 1000) and waveform.

entries.name: sound_effect_reverb
entries.description: Configures reverb parameters (gain in dB, mix, time, ratio) for a sound.

entries.name: sound_effect_compressor
entries.description: Configures compressor parameters (gain, attack, release, threshold, ratio, delay) for a sound.

entries.name: sound_effect_equalizer
entries.description: Configures equalizer with center frequency (80 to 16000 Hz), bandwidth and gain.

entries.name: sound_3d_set_sound_position
entries.description: Places a 3D sound at (x,y,z) meters relative to the listener, which affects loudness.

entries.name: sound_3d_set_sound_velocity
entries.description: Sets a 3D sound velocity vector, used only for doppler effects; it does not move the sound.

entries.name: sound_3d_set_sound_distance
entries.description: Sets distance (meters) below which volume is max and beyond which the sound is inaudible; defaults 1 and 1 billion.

entries.name: sound_3d_set_sound_cone
entries.description: Makes a 3D sound directional with direction x,y,z, inner and outer angles, and outside volume reduction.

entries.name: cd_init
entries.description: Initializes CD access; call before other CD functions and again when the disc changes.

entries.name: cd_present
entries.description: Returns whether a CD is in the default CD drive.

entries.name: cd_number
entries.description: Returns the number of tracks on the CD.

entries.name: cd_playing
entries.description: Returns whether the CD is currently playing.

entries.name: cd_paused
entries.description: Returns whether the CD is paused or stopped.

entries.name: cd_track
entries.description: Returns the current track number, where 1 is the first.

entries.name: cd_length
entries.description: Returns the total CD length in milliseconds.

entries.name: cd_track_length
entries.description: Returns the length of track n in milliseconds.

entries.name: cd_position
entries.description: Returns the current position on the whole CD in milliseconds.

entries.name: cd_track_position
entries.description: Returns the current position within the playing track in milliseconds.

entries.name: cd_play
entries.description: Plays CD tracks from first through last; use 1 and 1000 for the whole disc.

entries.name: cd_stop
entries.description: Stops CD playback.

entries.name: cd_pause
entries.description: Pauses CD playback.

entries.name: cd_resume
entries.description: Resumes paused CD playback.

entries.name: cd_set_position
entries.description: Seeks to a position on the CD in milliseconds.

entries.name: cd_set_track_position
entries.description: Seeks within the current track to a position in milliseconds.

entries.name: cd_open_door
entries.description: Opens the CD drive tray.

entries.name: cd_close_door
entries.description: Closes the CD drive tray.

entries.name: MCI_command
entries.description: Sends a command string to the Windows Media Control Interface and returns its reply string; advanced use.

entries.name: splash_show_video
entries.description: Shows a video file as a splash screen, optionally looping; supported formats depend on installed codecs.

entries.name: splash_show_text
entries.description: Shows a txt or rtf file as a splash screen for a delay in ms; zero or negative waits for Escape or click.

entries.name: splash_show_web
entries.description: Shows a web page (URL or full local path) as a splash screen for a delay in milliseconds.

entries.name: splash_show_image
entries.description: Shows a static image file as a splash screen for a delay in milliseconds.

entries.name: splash_set_caption
entries.description: Sets the caption of a separate splash window.

entries.name: splash_set_fullscreen
entries.description: Chooses whether a separate splash window is full screen; default is normal window.

entries.name: splash_set_border
entries.description: Chooses whether a separate splash window has a border; default true.

entries.name: splash_set_size
entries.description: Sets the size of a separate splash window; default 640x480.

entries.name: splash_set_position
entries.description: Sets the screen position of a separate splash window; default is chosen by Windows.

entries.name: splash_set_adapt
entries.description: Chooses whether the splash window resizes to the scaled video or image; default true.

entries.name: splash_set_top
entries.description: Chooses whether the splash window stays above other windows; default true.

entries.name: splash_set_color
entries.description: Sets the color of the area surrounding the splash image or video.

entries.name: splash_set_main
entries.description: Chooses whether splash shows in the main game window (true, default) or a separate window.

entries.name: splash_set_scale
entries.description: Sets the scale for splash video or image; 0 (default) scales to fill the window.

entries.name: splash_set_cursor
entries.description: Sets whether the mouse cursor is visible during splash; default visible, cannot be hidden for movies.

entries.name: splash_set_interrupt
entries.description: Chooses whether game play pauses while a separate splash window is shown; default true.

entries.name: splash_set_stop_key
entries.description: Chooses whether pressing Escape ends the splash screen; default true.

entries.name: splash_set_stop_mouse
entries.description: Chooses whether a mouse click in the splash ends it; default true.

entries.name: splash_set_close_button
entries.description: Chooses whether a close button appears at the splash top right; default true.

entries.name: show_info
entries.description: Displays the game information window.

entries.name: load_info
entries.description: Loads game information from an rtf file (no images) so different help text can be shown.

entries.name: show_message
entries.description: Shows a message dialog with the given text.

entries.name: show_message_ext
entries.description: Shows a message with up to three buttons (empty text hides one, & marks shortcut); returns pressed button number, 0 for Esc.

entries.name: show_question
entries.description: Shows a yes/no question; returns true if yes is chosen.

entries.name: get_integer
entries.description: Prompts the player for a number with a default value and returns it.

entries.name: get_string
entries.description: Prompts the player for a string with a default value and returns it.

entries.name: message_background
entries.description: Sets a background resource as the image behind pop-up dialogs; alpha ignored, but transparent bottom-left pixel color is keyed out.

entries.name: message_button
entries.description: Sets the three-image sprite (normal, hover, pressed) used for dialog buttons.

entries.name: message_alpha
entries.description: Sets pop-up translucency from 0 (fully translucent) to 1 (opaque).

entries.name: message_text_font
entries.description: Sets font name, size, color and style (0 normal, 1 bold, 2 italic, 3 both) for dialog text.

entries.name: message_button_font
entries.description: Sets font name, size, color and style for dialog button text.

entries.name: message_input_font
entries.description: Sets font name, size, color and style for the dialog input field.

entries.name: message_text_charset
entries.description: Selects the character set used by dialogs for a given text type.

entries.name: message_mouse_color
entries.description: Sets the button font color used when the mouse is over a dialog button.

entries.name: message_input_color
entries.description: Sets the background color of the dialog input field.

entries.name: message_position
entries.description: Sets the screen position of pop-up dialogs; -1,-1 centers them.

entries.name: message_size
entries.description: Fixes dialog size; -1 width uses the image width, -1 height depends on line count.

entries.name: message_caption
entries.description: Sets whether dialogs show a border (1/0) and the caption text.

entries.name: show_menu
entries.description: Shows a popup menu from a bar-separated string; returns chosen index or the default if none.

entries.name: show_menu_pos
entries.description: Same as show_menu but displayed at screen position x,y.

entries.name: get_color
entries.description: Asks the player to pick a color starting from a default; returns -1 if cancelled.

entries.name: get_open_filename
entries.description: Shows an open-file dialog with name|mask|... filter; returns empty string if cancelled.

entries.name: get_save_filename
entries.description: Shows a save-file dialog with a filter; returns empty string if cancelled.

entries.name: get_directory
entries.description: Asks for a directory starting at a default name; returns empty string if cancelled.

entries.name: get_directory_alt
entries.description: Alternative directory chooser with caption and tree root (empty for all); empty string if cancelled.

entries.name: show_error
entries.description: Shows a standard error message and/or logs it, optionally aborting the game.

entries.name: highscore_show_ext
entries.description: Shows the highscore table with custom background, border, colors, font name and size; numb -1 only displays.

entries.name: highscore_show
entries.description: Shows the highscore table, letting the player enter a name if numb qualifies; -1 just displays.

entries.name: highscore_set_background
entries.description: Sets which background resource is used for the highscore table.

entries.name: highscore_set_border
entries.description: Sets whether the highscore window has a border.

entries.name: highscore_set_font
entries.description: Chooses the font name, point size and style (0 regular, 1 bold, 2 italic, 3 bold+italic) of the highscore table.

entries.name: highscore_set_strings
entries.description: Overrides the caption, empty-slot text and escape hint strings of the table, e.g. for translation.

entries.name: highscore_set_colors
entries.description: Sets background, new-entry and other-entry colors of the table.

entries.name: highscore_clear
entries.description: Clears all highscore entries.

entries.name: highscore_add
entries.description: Adds an entry with the given name and score to the list.

entries.name: highscore_add_current
entries.description: Adds the current score to the list, asking the player for a name.

entries.name: highscore_value
entries.description: Returns the score at the given rank (1 to 10).

entries.name: highscore_name
entries.description: Returns the name at the given rank (1 to 10).

entries.name: draw_highscore
entries.description: Draws the highscore table inside the given box using the current font.

entries.name: sprite_exists

entries.description: Returns the top edge of the sprite bounding box.

entries.name: sprite_get_bbox_bottom
entries.description: Returns the bottom edge of the sprite bounding box.

entries.name: sprite_save

entries.name: sprite_save_strip
entries.description: Saves all subimages of a sprite as a horizontal strip in a png file.

entries.name: sound_get_preload
entries.description: Returns whether the sound is set to preload.

entries.name: sound_discard
entries.description: Frees the audio memory used by the sound.

entries.name: sound_restore
entries.description: Reloads the sound into audio memory so it can play immediately.

entries.name: background_exists

entries.name: background_get_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the background.

entries.name: background_get_width
entries.description: Returns the width of the background.

entries.name: background_get_height
entries.description: Returns the height of the background.

entries.name: background_save
entries.description: Saves the background to a png file.

entries.name: font_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a font with this index exists.

entries.name: font_get_name
entries.description: Returns the resource name of the font.

entries.name: font_get_fontname
entries.description: Returns the underlying typeface name of the font.

entries.name: font_get_bold
entries.description: Returns whether the font is bold.

entries.name: font_get_italic
entries.description: Returns whether the font is italic.

entries.name: font_get_first
entries.description: Returns the first character index in the font.

entries.name: font_get_last
entries.description: Returns the last character index in the font.

entries.name: path_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a path with this index exists.

entries.name: path_get_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the path.

entries.name: path_get_length
entries.description: Returns the total length of the path.

entries.name: path_get_kind
entries.description: Returns the connection kind of the path: 0 straight, 1 smooth.

entries.name: path_get_closed
entries.description: Returns whether the path is closed.

entries.name: path_get_precision
entries.description: Returns the precision used when smoothing the path.

entries.name: path_get_number
entries.description: Returns the number of defining points of the path.

entries.name: path_get_point_x

entries.name: path_get_point_y
entries.description: Returns the y of the n-th defining point (0-based).

entries.description: Returns the x coordinate at relative position pos (0 to 1) along the path.

entries.description: Returns the speed factor at relative position pos (0 to 1) along the path.

entries.description: Returns whether a script with this index exists.

entries.name: script_get_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the script.

entries.name: script_get_text
entries.description: Returns the code text of the script.

entries.name: timeline_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a time line with this index exists.

entries.name: timeline_get_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the time line.

entries.description: Returns whether an object with this index exists.

entries.name: object_get_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the object.

entries.name: object_get_sprite
entries.description: Returns the object default sprite index.

entries.name: object_get_solid
entries.description: Returns whether the object is solid by default.

entries.name: object_get_visible
entries.description: Returns whether the object is visible by default.

entries.name: object_get_depth
entries.description: Returns the object default depth.

entries.name: object_get_persistent
entries.description: Returns whether the object is persistent by default.

entries.name: object_get_mask
entries.description: Returns the object mask sprite index, -1 if none.

entries.name: object_get_parent
entries.description: Returns the parent object index, negative if none.

entries.name: object_is_ancestor
entries.description: True when object ind2 is a parent, grandparent, etc. of object ind1.

entries.name: room_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a room with this index exists.

entries.name: room_get_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the room.

entries.name: sprite_set_offset
entries.description: Sets the origin offset of a sprite.

entries.name: sprite_duplicate
entries.description: Copies a sprite and returns the new index, or -1 on error.

entries.name: sprite_assign
entries.description: Makes the sprite a copy of another sprite.

entries.name: sprite_merge
entries.description: Appends the images of the second sprite onto the first, stretching if sizes differ; second is kept.

entries.name: sprite_add
entries.description: Loads an image file (optionally a strip of subimages) as a new sprite and returns its index, with options for transparency, smoothing and origin.

entries.name: sprite_replace
entries.description: Like sprite_add but replaces an existing sprite; returns success.

entries.name: sprite_add_sprite
entries.description: Loads a .gmspr sprite file as a new sprite and returns its index, or -1 on error.

entries.name: sprite_replace_sprite
entries.description: Like sprite_add_sprite but replaces an existing sprite; returns success.

entries.name: sprite_create_from_screen
entries.description: Creates a sprite by copying a screen (drawing region) area and returns its index.

entries.name: sprite_add_from_screen
entries.description: Appends a screen area as another subimage of the sprite.

entries.name: sprite_create_from_surface
entries.description: Creates a sprite from an area of a surface, preserving alpha, and returns its index.

entries.name: sprite_add_from_surface
entries.description: Appends an area of a surface as another subimage of the sprite.

entries.name: sprite_delete
entries.description: Removes the sprite from memory.

entries.name: sprite_set_alpha_from_sprite

entries.description: Copies a file to a new name.

entries.name: file_bin_close

entries.description: Returns the current byte position in the binary file, starting at 0.

entries.description: Deletes the whole section from the INI file.

entries.name: part_type_create
entries.description: Creates a new particle type and returns its index.

entries.name: part_type_destroy
entries.description: Destroys a particle type to free memory.

entries.name: part_type_exists
entries.description: Returns whether the particle type exists.

entries.name: part_type_clear
entries.description: Resets the particle type to default settings.

entries.name: part_type_shape
entries.description: Sets the particle shape to a pt_shape_ constant (default pt_shape_pixel).

entries.name: part_type_sprite
entries.description: Uses a sprite for the particle, with flags for animation, stretching over lifetime, and random start subimage.

entries.name: part_type_size
entries.description: Sets min and max starting size, per-step size change, and size wiggle (default size 1).

entries.name: part_type_scale
entries.description: Sets horizontal and vertical scale factors multiplied with the size.

entries.name: part_type_orientation
entries.description: Sets angle min/max, per-step change, wiggle and whether the angle is relative to the motion direction.

entries.name: part_type_life
entries.description: Sets minimum and maximum particle lifetime in steps (default 100 each).

entries.name: part_type_step
entries.description: Sets how many particles of a type are spawned each step; negative values mean a 1/-number chance per step.

entries.name: part_type_death
entries.description: Sets how many particles of a type spawn when one dies of old age; negative means a chance.

entries.name: part_type_speed
entries.description: Sets min/max starting speed, per-step speed change (never below 0), and wiggle.

entries.name: part_type_direction
entries.description: Sets direction range in counterclockwise degrees (0 = right), per-step change, and wiggle.

entries.name: part_type_gravity
entries.description: Sets gravity amount added each step and its direction (270 is down).

entries.name: part_type_color1
entries.description: Gives the particle a single color.

entries.name: part_type_color2
entries.description: Interpolates the particle color between two colors over its life.

entries.name: part_type_color3
entries.description: Interpolates the particle color between three colors at start, middle and end.

entries.name: part_type_color_mix
entries.description: Gives each particle a fixed color randomly mixed from two colors.

entries.name: part_type_color_rgb
entries.description: Gives each particle a fixed color chosen from RGB ranges (0-255 each).

entries.name: part_type_color_hsv
entries.description: Gives each particle a fixed color chosen from HSV ranges (0-255 each).

entries.name: part_type_alpha1
entries.description: Sets a single alpha transparency (0-1) for the particle type.

entries.name: part_type_alpha2
entries.description: Interpolates alpha between a start and end value.

entries.name: part_type_alpha3
entries.description: Interpolates alpha between three values over the particle life.

entries.name: part_type_blend
entries.description: Selects additive (1) or normal (0) blending for the particle type.

entries.name: part_system_create
entries.description: Creates a new particle system and returns its index.

entries.name: part_system_destroy
entries.description: Destroys a particle system to free memory.

entries.name: part_system_exists
entries.description: Returns whether the particle system exists.

entries.name: part_system_clear
entries.description: Resets the system to defaults, removing all particles, emitters and attractors.

entries.name: part_system_draw_order
entries.description: Chooses draw order: true draws oldest particles first (default), false newest first.

entries.name: part_system_depth
entries.description: Sets the depth of the particle system relative to instances.

entries.name: part_system_position
entries.description: Sets the offset position at which the system is drawn, e.g. to follow an object.

entries.name: part_system_automatic_update
entries.description: Sets whether the system updates automatically (1, default) or not (0).

entries.name: part_system_automatic_draw
entries.description: Sets whether the system draws automatically (1, default) or not (0).

entries.name: part_system_update
entries.description: Advances particle positions and emitters one step; needed only when updating is manual.

entries.name: part_system_drawit
entries.description: Draws the system particles; needed only for manual drawing, call from a draw event.

entries.name: part_particles_create
entries.description: Creates a number of particles of a type at (x,y) in the system.

entries.name: part_particles_create_color
entries.description: Creates particles of a type at (x,y) with a given color; useful for single-color or colorless types.

entries.name: part_particles_clear
entries.description: Removes all particles from the system.

entries.name: part_particles_count
entries.description: Returns the number of particles in the system.

entries.name: part_emitter_create
entries.description: Creates an emitter in the particle system and returns its index.

entries.name: part_emitter_destroy
entries.description: Destroys an emitter in the particle system.

entries.name: part_emitter_destroy_all
entries.description: Destroys all emitters in the particle system.

entries.name: part_emitter_exists
entries.description: Returns whether an emitter with that index exists in the system.

entries.name: part_emitter_clear
entries.description: Resets an emitter to default settings.

entries.name: part_emitter_region
entries.description: Sets the emitter region extents, shape and distribution.

entries.name: part_emitter_burst
entries.description: Emits a single burst of a number of particles of a type.

entries.name: part_emitter_stream
entries.description: Continuously emits a number of particles per step; negative means a 1/-number chance per step.

entries.name: ps_distr_linear
entries.description: Emitter distribution constant: uniform chance across the region.

entries.name: ps_distr_gaussian
entries.description: Emitter distribution constant: more particles near the center.

entries.name: ps_distr_invgaussian
entries.description: Emitter distribution constant: more particles near the edges.

entries.name: ps_shape_rectangle
entries.description: Region shape constant for rectangle used by emitters, destroyers and changers.

entries.name: ps_shape_ellipse
entries.description: Region shape constant for ellipse used by emitters, destroyers and changers.

entries.name: ps_shape_diamond
entries.description: Region shape constant for diamond used by emitters, destroyers and changers.

entries.name: ps_shape_line
entries.description: Region shape constant for line used by emitters, destroyers and changers.

entries.name: part_attractor_create
entries.description: Creates an attractor in the particle system and returns its index.

entries.name: part_attractor_destroy
entries.description: Destroys an attractor in the particle system.

entries.name: part_attractor_destroy_all
entries.description: Destroys all attractors in the particle system.

entries.name: part_attractor_exists
entries.description: Returns whether an attractor with that index exists in the system.

entries.name: part_attractor_clear
entries.description: Resets an attractor to default settings.

entries.name: part_attractor_position
entries.description: Sets the attractor position to (x,y).

entries.name: part_attractor_force
entries.description: Sets attractor force, maximum effect distance, force kind and whether it is additive to speed.

entries.name: ps_force_constant
entries.description: Attractor force kind where the force does not depend on distance.

entries.name: ps_force_linear
entries.description: Attractor force kind growing linearly from 0 at max distance to full force at the attractor.

entries.name: ps_force_quadratic
entries.description: Attractor force kind that grows quadratically with closeness.

entries.name: part_destroyer_create
entries.description: Creates a destroyer in the particle system and returns its index.

entries.name: part_destroyer_destroy
entries.description: Destroys a destroyer in the particle system.

entries.name: part_destroyer_destroy_all
entries.description: Destroys all destroyers in the particle system.

entries.name: part_destroyer_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a destroyer with that index exists in the system.

entries.name: part_destroyer_clear
entries.description: Resets a destroyer to default settings.

entries.name: part_destroyer_region
entries.description: Sets the destroyer region extents and shape.

entries.name: part_deflector_create
entries.description: Creates a deflector in the particle system and returns its index.

entries.name: part_deflector_destroy
entries.description: Destroys a deflector in the particle system.

entries.name: part_deflector_destroy_all
entries.description: Destroys all deflectors in the particle system.

entries.name: part_deflector_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a deflector with that index exists in the system.

entries.name: part_deflector_clear
entries.description: Resets a deflector to default settings.

entries.name: part_deflector_region
entries.description: Sets the rectangular region in which the deflector acts.

entries.name: part_deflector_kind
entries.description: Sets the deflector kind (horizontal or vertical deflection).

entries.name: part_deflector_friction
entries.description: Sets how much particles are slowed on impact with the deflector.

entries.name: ps_deflect_vertical
entries.description: Deflector kind deflecting particles vertically, typically for horizontal walls.

entries.name: ps_deflect_horizontal
entries.description: Deflector kind deflecting particles horizontally, typically for vertical walls.

entries.name: part_changer_create

entries.name: part_changer_destroy
entries.description: Destroys a changer in the particle system.

entries.name: part_changer_destroy_all
entries.description: Destroys all changers in the particle system.

entries.name: part_changer_exists
entries.description: Returns whether a changer with that index exists in the system.

entries.name: part_changer_clear
entries.description: Resets a changer to default settings.

entries.name: part_changer_region
entries.description: Sets the changer region extents and shape.

entries.name: part_changer_kind
entries.description: Sets the changer kind (ps_change_motion, shape or all).

entries.name: part_changer_types
entries.description: Sets which particle type is turned into which other type.

entries.name: ps_change_all
entries.description: Changer kind altering all parameters, effectively replacing the particle with a new one.

entries.name: ps_change_shape
entries.description: Changer kind altering only shape-related parameters such as size and color.

entries.name: ps_change_motion
entries.description: Changer kind altering only motion parameters.

entries.name: mplay_init_ipx
entries.description: Sets up an IPX network connection for multiplayer.

entries.name: mplay_init_tcpip
entries.description: Sets up a TCP/IP connection; the address (with optional :port) is only needed when joining a session.

entries.name: mplay_init_modem
entries.description: Sets up a modem connection using an init string and, when joining, a phone number to dial.

entries.name: mplay_init_serial
entries.description: Sets up a serial connection from port, baud rate, stop bits, parity and flow control; returns success, and port 0 opens a settings dialog.

entries.name: mplay_connect_status
entries.description: Returns the connection type: 0 none, 1 IPX, 2 TCP/IP, 3 modem, 4 serial.

entries.name: mplay_end
entries.description: Closes the current multiplayer connection.

entries.name: mplay_ipaddress
entries.description: Returns this machine's IP address as a string; slow, so avoid calling every step.

entries.name: mplay_session_mode
entries.description: Chooses whether the session host migrates to another computer when the host leaves (default false).

entries.name: mplay_session_create
entries.description: Creates a session with a name, maximum player count (0 for unlimited) and your player name; returns success.

entries.name: mplay_session_find
entries.description: Looks for sessions still accepting players and returns how many were found.

entries.name: mplay_session_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the found session with the given index (0-based); call after mplay_session_find.

entries.name: mplay_session_join
entries.description: Joins the found session with the given index using your player name; returns success.

entries.name: mplay_session_status
entries.description: Returns session state: 0 none, 1 created, 2 joined.

entries.name: mplay_session_end
entries.description: Ends the session for this player.

entries.name: mplay_player_find
entries.description: Searches the current session for players and returns the number found.

entries.name: mplay_player_name
entries.description: Returns the name of the found player with the given index (0 is yourself); call after mplay_player_find.

entries.name: mplay_player_id
entries.description: Returns the unique id of the found player with the given index (0 is yourself), used for addressing messages.

entries.name: mplay_data_write
entries.description: Stores a real or string value in shared data slot ind (0 to 1000000).

entries.name: mplay_data_read
entries.description: Returns the shared data value at slot ind (0 to 1000000); all slots start at 0.

entries.name: mplay_data_mode
entries.description: Sets whether shared data uses guaranteed transmission (default true).

entries.name: mplay_message_send
entries.description: Sends a non-guaranteed message with an integer id and real or string value to a player (0 for all); strings up to 30000 characters.

entries.name: mplay_message_send_guaranteed
entries.description: Sends a guaranteed-delivery message with id and value to a player (0 for all); strings up to 30000 characters.

entries.name: mplay_message_receive
entries.description: Takes the next queued message from the given player (0 for any); returns whether one was available.

entries.name: mplay_message_id
entries.description: Returns the id of the most recently received message.

entries.name: mplay_message_value
entries.description: Returns the value of the most recently received message.

entries.name: mplay_message_player
entries.description: Returns the sender of the most recently received message.

entries.name: mplay_message_name
entries.description: Returns the sender's name for the most recently received message.

entries.name: mplay_message_count
entries.description: Returns how many messages are queued from the player (0 counts all).

entries.name: mplay_message_clear
entries.description: Discards queued messages from the player (0 discards all).

entries.name: external_call
entries.description: Calls a previously defined external function by id with matching real or string arguments and returns its result.

entries.name: external_define
entries.description: Defines an external DLL function: DLL name, function name, calling convention, result type, argument count (0-16) and argument types; returns an id.

entries.name: external_free
entries.description: Unloads the named DLL so it can be removed; best done at game end.

entries.name: get_function_address
entries.description: Returns the address of a built-in GameMaker function so DLLs can call it directly.

entries.name: window_handle
entries.description: Returns the window handle of the game's main window.

entries.name: ty_real
entries.description: Argument/result type constant marking a real-number value in external_define.

entries.name: ty_string
entries.description: Argument/result type constant marking a string value in external_define.

entries.name: dll_cdecl
entries.description: Calling-convention constant for external_define selecting cdecl.

entries.name: dll_stdcall
entries.description: Calling-convention constant for external_define selecting stdcall.

entries.name: d3d_start
entries.description: Switches to 3D mode; returns whether it succeeded.

entries.name: d3d_end
entries.description: Leaves 3D mode; returns whether it succeeded.

entries.name: d3d_set_hidden
entries.description: Turns depth testing (hidden surface removal) on or off.

entries.name: d3d_set_perspective
entries.description: Turns perspective projection on or off.

entries.name: d3d_set_depth
entries.description: Sets the depth value used for subsequent 2D drawing.

entries.name: d3d_set_zwriteenable
entries.description: Undocumented in this manual; appears to enable or disable writing to the depth buffer.

entries.name: d3d_primitive_begin
entries.description: Begins a 3D primitive of the given pr_ kind (points, lines, strips, triangles, fan).

entries.name: d3d_vertex
entries.description: Adds a vertex at (x,y,z) using the currently set color and alpha.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_color
entries.description: Adds a vertex with its own color and alpha, allowing gradients.

entries.name: d3d_primitive_end
entries.description: Finishes the primitive and draws it.

entries.name: d3d_primitive_begin_texture
entries.description: Begins a 3D primitive of the given kind that uses the given texture.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_texture
entries.description: Adds a vertex with texture coordinates, blended with the current color and alpha.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_texture_color
entries.description: Adds a vertex with texture coordinates and its own color and alpha.

entries.name: d3d_draw_block
entries.description: Draws a block between two opposite corners in the current color; texid -1 means no texture; hrepeat and vrepeat set texture tiling per face.

entries.name: d3d_draw_cylinder
entries.description: Draws a vertical cylinder in a bounding box; closed caps the ends, steps sets rotational detail (about 24); texid -1 means no texture; hrepeat and vrepeat set texture tiling per face.

entries.name: d3d_draw_cone
entries.description: Draws a vertical cone in a bounding box; closed caps the base, steps sets detail (about 24); texid -1 means no texture; hrepeat and vrepeat set texture tiling per face.

entries.name: d3d_draw_ellipsoid
entries.description: Draws an ellipsoid in a bounding box with steps rotational detail (about 24); texid -1 means no texture; hrepeat and vrepeat set texture tiling per face.

entries.name: d3d_draw_wall
entries.description: Draws a vertical wall between two corners; texid -1 means no texture; hrepeat and vrepeat set texture tiling per face.

entries.name: d3d_draw_floor
entries.description: Draws a possibly slanted floor between two corners; texid -1 means no texture; hrepeat and vrepeat set texture tiling per face.

entries.name: d3d_set_projection
entries.description: Sets the camera from a position, a target point and an up vector.

entries.name: d3d_set_projection_ext
entries.description: Like d3d_set_projection but also takes field-of-view angle, aspect ratio and near/far clipping planes.

entries.name: d3d_set_projection_ortho
entries.description: Sets an orthographic projection of a room area, rotated by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_set_projection_perspective
entries.description: Sets a perspective projection of a room area, rotated by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_identity
entries.description: Resets the world transformation to identity.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_translation
entries.description: Replaces the transformation with a translation by the given vector.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_scaling
entries.description: Replaces the transformation with a scaling by the given factors.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_rotation_x
entries.description: Replaces the transformation with a rotation about the x-axis by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_rotation_y
entries.description: Replaces the transformation with a rotation about the y-axis by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_rotation_z
entries.description: Replaces the transformation with a rotation about the z-axis by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_transform_set_rotation_axis
entries.description: Replaces the transformation with a rotation about an arbitrary axis vector by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_transform_add_translation
entries.description: Appends a translation by the given vector to the transformation.

entries.name: d3d_transform_add_scaling
entries.description: Appends a scaling by the given factors to the transformation.

entries.name: d3d_transform_add_rotation_x
entries.description: Appends a rotation about the x-axis by the given angle to the transformation.

entries.name: d3d_transform_add_rotation_y
entries.description: Appends a rotation about the y-axis by the given angle to the transformation.

entries.name: d3d_transform_add_rotation_z
entries.description: Appends a rotation about the z-axis by the given angle to the transformation.

entries.name: d3d_transform_add_rotation_axis
entries.description: Appends a rotation about an arbitrary axis vector by the given angle.

entries.name: d3d_transform_stack_clear
entries.description: Empties the transformation stack.

entries.name: d3d_transform_stack_empty
entries.description: Returns whether the transformation stack has no entries.

entries.name: d3d_transform_stack_push
entries.description: Pushes the current transformation onto the stack; returns whether there was room.

entries.name: d3d_transform_stack_pop
entries.description: Pops the top transformation and makes it current; returns whether the stack had one.

entries.name: d3d_transform_stack_top
entries.description: Makes the top stack transformation current without removing it; returns whether one existed.

entries.name: d3d_transform_stack_discard
entries.description: Removes the top stack transformation without making it current; returns whether one existed.

entries.name: d3d_set_fog
entries.description: Enables or disables fog with a color, a start distance and an end distance where visibility is fully lost.

entries.name: d3d_set_lighting
entries.description: Enables or disables lighting.

entries.name: d3d_set_shading
entries.description: Chooses smooth (true) or flat shading.

entries.name: d3d_set_culling
entries.description: Turns backface culling on or off.

entries.name: d3d_light_define_ambient
entries.description: Sets the ambient light color, the baseline brightness of unlit areas (default black).

entries.name: d3d_light_define_direction
entries.description: Defines directional light ind with direction vector and color; does not enable it.

entries.name: d3d_light_define_point
entries.description: Defines point light ind at a position with a range over which intensity falls off, and a color; does not enable it.

entries.name: d3d_light_enable
entries.description: Turns light number ind on or off.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_normal
entries.description: Adds a vertex with a normal vector for lighting.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_normal_color
entries.description: Adds a vertex with normal vector and its own color and alpha.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_normal_texture
entries.description: Adds a vertex with normal and texture coordinates, blended with the current color and alpha.

entries.name: d3d_vertex_normal_texture_color
entries.description: Adds a vertex with normal, texture coordinates and its own color and alpha.

entries.name: d3d_model_create

entries.name: d3d_model_destroy
entries.description: Destroys the model and frees its memory.

entries.name: d3d_model_clear
entries.description: Removes all primitives from the model.

entries.name: d3d_model_save
entries.description: Saves the model to a file.

entries.name: d3d_model_load
entries.description: Loads the model from a file.

entries.name: d3d_model_draw
entries.description: Draws the model at (x,y,z) with the given texture (-1 for none); use transforms to rotate or scale.

entries.name: d3d_model_primitive_begin

entries.name: d3d_model_vertex

entries.name: d3d_model_vertex_color

entries.name: d3d_model_vertex_normal_color

entries.name: d3d_model_vertex_normal_texture
entries.description: Adds a vertex with normal and texture coordinates to the model.

entries.name: d3d_model_vertex_normal_texture_color
entries.description: Adds a vertex with normal, texture coordinates, color and alpha to the model.

entries.name: d3d_model_primitive_end
entries.description: Ends the current primitive in the model.

entries.name: d3d_model_block

entries.name: d3d_model_cylinder
entries.description: Adds a cylinder shape to the model.

entries.name: d3d_model_cone
entries.description: Adds a cone shape to the model.

entries.name: d3d_model_ellipsoid

entries.name: os_device
entries.description: Read-only variable further classifying the device, e.g. device_ios_iphone, device_ios_ipad.

entries.name: display_aa
entries.description: Read-only bitmask of supported antialiasing levels (2 = 2x, 4 = 4x, 8 = 8x bits summed, e.g. 14 for all).
